inputSpecification: The model requires true orthos in tiff or png format. Input images must be 1024x1024 pixels. Orthos must be provided as a 3-channel image with 8 - 10 cm resolution.
outputSpecification:
The model outputs a YOLOv26 text file containing one line for every detection containing a class id and ploygon in local (0.0-1.0) coordinates

Classes that are detected:

- manure_open
- industrial
- manure_closed
- (rain)water storage
- wastewater_treatment
- feed_silo
- thermal_storage
- horizontal_tank
- propane_tank
- pond_basin
trainingDataOrigin: The model has been trained on true orthos from different parts of The Netherlands.
moreInformation: Geo Expertise Centre of Kadaster Nederland
